name: SparkplugPanel
description: Sparkplug session view: connection and alias banners with a bulk rebirth request, fleet summary with a problems filter, host state strip, virtualised group/node/device/metric tree, and a clickable warnings strip. Explains and offers to turn on decoding when it is off.

props.name: treeState
props.description: SparkplugTreeState snapshot from the sparkplug tree store (plain state in, so stories can feed fixtures).

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width for the virtual-list row max-width math.

props.name: filter
props.description: Search text. Matches group, node, device and metric names, Group/Node paths, "alias N" and pasted Sparkplug topics. Opens everything while set.

props.name: decodingState
props.description: off or needs-reconnect replaces the tree with an explanation and a button.

props.name: enablingDecoding
props.description: True while decoding is being turned on; the button disables and says so.

props.name: onEnableDecoding
props.description: Turns decoding on for the connection and connects, or reconnects when already connected.

props.name: onRequestRebirth
props.description: ([{group, node, offline?}]) asks for rebirths; the caller confirms before anything is published.

props.name: onCopyMetricList
props.description: (node) callback for the Copy metric list action.

props.name: onSelectMetric
props.description: (metric) opens the message that last set the metric's value.

props.name: onClearFilter
props.description: Clears the search, so a warning click can reveal a node the search hides.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; stories use local fixtures. Expansion is panel-local: groups open, nodes open by default only while the tree holds 400 metrics or fewer, and that choice holds from the user's first click, scroll or key so rows never collapse under them, and the user's clicks override per key. The tree is one tab stop with arrow-key navigation (aria-activedescendant). Below 560px wide the rows go compact.
